acceptance: RUBRIC 1 Before 2027-01-05, every current dated directive (322 at c962e3e) is renewed or removed through the required oracle-reviewed policy change
RUBRIC 2 A non-blocking warning surfaces in local checks and CI/nightly at least 30 days before any directive expiry
RUBRIC 3 Expiries are staggered so no single date holds more than 10% of dated directives
RUBRIC 4 Tests cover the warning boundary, validity through the expiry date, hard failure the following day, and that a date-only renewal still requires oracle review
RUBRIC 5 The renewal owner and process are documented
context: Found 2026-10-23 while reviewing PR #3362; confirmed by the Advisor review 2026-10-24 (headline 3).
description: All 322 dated exceptions in quality/comment-policy.json (at develop c962e3e) are directives with `expires: 2027-01-04`. An exception is expired when `expires < date.today()` (scripts/check_comment_policy.py:61-67) and, since #3362, expired-exception findings are always in the failure set (:481). So from 2027-01-05 every strict commit hook run, PR CI comment-policy job and the nightly whole-tree scan fails until the policy is updated. There is no advance warning and no staggering; renewals are new policy entries that require oracle review (docs/internal/comment-policy.md:120-130).
